$comment: The TERMBASE: every protected term, kept OUT of the strings. scripts/extract-strings.mjs tags each inventory message with the terms it contains (every `forms` spelling counts as the term; longest form first; case-sensitive whole words) and flags as off-glossary any form listed under a term's `avoid` (case-sensitive) or in the top-level `avoid` list (any case). Classes — frozen: English in every locale, never translated · game: the game ships an official translation in every locale; take it from the game's text (genshin-db), never translate it ourselves · label: the English label stays, its explanation translates · house: our own coined term; it DOES translate, but once per locale, fixed here, and reused everywhere. Rulings live in docs/text/glossary.md; this file is the machine-readable half. `proposed` marks an entry that is Claude's suggestion, not yet ruled.
